purpose: Test whether reconstructed resource expansion and host-contribution concentration are artifacts of agricultural crop hosts.

crop_definition.authority: FAO Indicative Crop Classification, Appendix 4 alphabetical list of crops with botanical names
crop_definition.exact_species_rule: Exclude a resolved WCVP host when its accepted binomial exactly matches a botanical binomial parsed from the FAO crop list.
crop_definition.conservative_genus_rule: In addition to exact binomials, exclude every resolved host species whose genus is represented by an FAO botanical entry using spp.; this intentionally over-excludes non-crop congeners and is a conservative sensitivity.
crop_definition.note: Original LepTraits host-family breadth is retained as the specialization predictor; crop exclusion changes reconstructed resource geography, not the definition of the butterfly diet trait.

reconstruction.native_host_units: WCVP v13 introduced=0, extinct=0, location_doubtful=0 at WGSRPD3
reconstruction.contemporary_host_units: WCVP v13 extinct=0, location_doubtful=0 at WGSRPD3, retaining native and introduced records
reconstruction.operation: Remove crop-classified host species before taking butterfly-level native and contemporary unions.
reconstruction.reason: Unit overlap among hosts means crop contributions cannot be subtracted from aggregate fractional credits after the fact.

outputs: total native species x WGSRPD3 units

populations.full: Original 239 resource-eligible butterflies; species with no non-crop native resource after exclusion are reported and omitted only from species-level ratios/correlations.
populations.adequate: Original host-taxonomy-lower-bound-adequate butterflies, with the adequacy flag inherited from the primary analysis.

claim_boundary: Sensitivity analysis only; it does not redefine the primary WCVP introduced-distribution estimand.
WCVP introduced status represents wild non-native distributions, not cultivated acreage.
Purely cultivated or merely planted non-self-reproducing records are not WCVP introduced distributions.
The conservative genus-expanded crop sensitivity may remove genuinely wild non-crop congeners and therefore is deliberately over-conservative.

reporting_policy.primary_manuscript_change: Methods clarification of WCVP introduced semantics only.
reporting_policy.supporting_information: Report the FAO exact-binomial crop exclusion as the main crop sensitivity in one compact SI table/paragraph.
reporting_policy.conservative_genus_variant: Report only as an over-conservative sensitivity column or parenthetical; do not use it to redefine the primary estimand.

interpretation.robust: If the exact-binomial exclusion preserves broad expansion and the near-zero host-breadth association while portfolio architecture retains the same directional pattern, state only that conclusions were robust to exclusion of FAO-defined crop hosts.
interpretation.qualified: If crop exclusion materially changes any central pattern, report the changed result transparently and qualify the corresponding claim rather than tuning the crop definition.
